goal: Speed up block template validation latency for miners and Stratum v2 services
Prevent dummy check lookups during template validation from polluting the main coins cache
agreement: Concept support for accelerating block checks for Stratum v2 (Sjors, optout21)
Agreed reentrancy guard inside template validity checks is not yet pushed (l0rinc)
Contested objection: prefetching can retain up to 250 MiB of coins without proof-of-work protection (l0rinc)
AssembleBlock benchmark regression was addressed with max-weight test blocks (sedited)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it significantly reduces template validation latency for miners and Stratum v2 services
Avoids polluting the primary UTXO cache with cache misses from speculative block checks
